name: notes_agent
description: A notes and knowledge management agent. Can save meeting notes, search through existing notes, read note files, and list all saved notes. Uses Google Cloud Storage for persistent storage.

skills.name: Save Note
skills.description: Save a note as a markdown file in cloud storage with descriptive filename and formatted content.

skills.name: Read Note
skills.description: Read the contents of a specific note file from cloud storage.

skills.name: List Notes
skills.description: List all saved notes in cloud storage sorted by last modified time.

skills.name: Search Notes
skills.description: Search through note contents for specific text with matching excerpts.
